description: Start a job to split one of the user's 3D models into parts or fill its hidden surfaces: method shape (Tripo Segment), name (Tripo Smart Segment, GLB models only, optional hint), fill (Tripo Mesh Complete fills hidden surfaces) or seal (Tripo Mesh Complete closes the holes quickly). Parts have generic names. Price by method: shape 55 Gold, name 75 Gold, fill 125 Gold, seal 95 Gold. First call chargen_quote_3d_split, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job, which gives the model file (media_url, model_format) when it is done. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

granularity.description: shape with segment_version v2.0 only: how finely to split (default balanced).

hint.description: name only: optional guidance for the parts, for example "sword, shield, helmet".

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

method.description: shape: split by shape (Tripo Segment). name: split into named kinds of part (Tripo Smart Segment, GLB models only). fill: fill hidden surfaces (Tripo Mesh Complete). seal: close the holes quickly (Tripo Mesh Complete quick cap).

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

part_granularity.description: name only: how finely to split (default medium).

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_3d_split. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

segment_version.description: shape, fill and seal: the segmentation version (default v1.0).

split_by_connectivity.description: shape with segment_version v2.0 only: also split pieces that do not touch.

name: chargen_edit_3d_split
title: Split 3D model
